mapping_doctrine.composition_rule: Stage 2A resolves the governing local-solar half and source-owned nominal schedule while Paksha remains caller supplied. Stage 2D maps that schedule without changing its bird, activity, chronology, rational offset, or locator facts.
mapping_doctrine.fraction_rule: For every exact nominal endpoint n and nominal schedule span N, retain f=n/N as an exact reduced fraction. The fixed 1440-second nazhigai conversion is not used.
mapping_doctrine.time_rule: Convert the governing solar-half anchor and end through the same reader to TT. Every interior endpoint is computed independently as anchor_jd_tt plus float(f) times the complete governing solar-half TT span; cell durations are never accumulated.
mapping_doctrine.closure_rule: The zero endpoint is exactly the Stage 2A anchor and the final endpoint is exactly the Stage 2A governing solar-half end in both TT and published UT1. Interior TT endpoints are projected back to UT1 through the same reader.
mapping_doctrine.boundary_rule: All 25 cells are contiguous, positive, and half-open. Shared endpoints belong to the following cell and the governing solar-half endpoint is excluded.
mapping_doctrine.repair_rule: No clipping, wrapping, repetition, fixed-span borrowing, or tail fabrication occurs because the normalized schedule closes exactly on the governing solar half by construction.
mapping_doctrine.current_cell_rule: This admission materializes the complete proportional schedule but does not select or claim a current cell.
mapping_doctrine.polar_policy: Fail explicitly when lawful sunrise and sunset bounds do not exist.

validation_evidence.fraction_semantics: all exact nominal endpoint fractions are reduced, ordered, contiguous, positive by cell, and close exactly from zero to one
validation_evidence.mapping_semantics: every TT endpoint is independently derived from the common anchor and complete solar-half span rather than accumulated durations
validation_evidence.closure_semantics: the first and final TT and UT1 endpoints equal the governing solar-half bounds exactly
validation_evidence.interval_semantics: all 25 half-open cells are positive and contiguous for long and short day and night halves
validation_evidence.time_scale_semantics: interior endpoints are mapped on reader-bound TT and projected to UT1 through the same reader
validation_evidence.detached_vessel_boundary: The detached result validates exact fraction-to-TT mapping, outer UT1 closure, and UT1 ordering and contiguity. Reader-dependent interior TT-to-UT1 inverse truth is established by the governing factory path and reader-bound tests because the result vessel does not retain the configured reader.
validation_evidence.capability_semantics: profile admission and solar_proportional_materialization capability are checked before astronomical resolution
validation_evidence.provenance_semantics: result provenance distinguishes absent historical attestation from the performed modern composition

public_claim: Given an explicit profile, UT1 instant, location, and caller-supplied Purva or Amara source label, resolve the governing local-solar half and nominal schedule, preserve every exact nominal offset as a fraction of that schedule span, map those fractions independently across the complete governing TT half, project interior endpoints to UT1, and return 25 contiguous half-open cells that close exactly at the astronomical half end.

a current Pancha Pakshi activity or schedule cell

condition evaluation, scoring, or electional window search
